source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary: Whenever this weapon hits a unit that is a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**, the bearer gains a benefit for the rest of the turn if it picks that unit as a charge target: its [Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step) get +2, and no enemy unit can use **[Fire Overwatch](vsdata:core-rule/fire-overwatch)** on the bearer.

detail.condition: bearer declares a charge against that unit
